title: Mir Publishers and Science Popularisation in the Global South: data, code and working paper
description: Data, code and working paper for a digital-humanities study of the Mir Titles collection on the Internet Archive: 4,566 digitised Soviet books in 25 languages. Science is half the collection but 87% of downloads; in Indian languages, 70% of science titles are popular science against 15% in English; Indian-language items rose from 5% to 31% of uploads after 2020.
